project_type: AWS CDK (Python) 3-stack app + EC2 FFmpeg worker (Python) + FastAPI JSON API (Python) + vanilla HTML/JS SPA + a DLQ-consumer Lambda (Python). Greenfield build inside an existing Obsidian/learning-journal monorepo; all new code lives under projects/video-streaming-app/.
language: Python 3.12 (CDK, worker, api, lambda); vanilla ES-module JavaScript + HTML/CSS (SPA).
build_system: The CDK app under projects/video-streaming-app/iac/ is self-contained with its own venv + requirements.txt (aws-cdk-lib>=2.170.0,<3, constructs>=10). CDK CLI invoked via `npx cdk` (no global install needed). cdk.json app command is `python3 app.py`. QUIRK: `cdk synth` needs the ffmpeg BucketDeployment asset dir non-empty -- run iac/scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh BEFORE synth or synth fails by design. QUIRK: keep synth credential-free -- define the VPC in-stack (NO ec2.Vpc.from_lookup), set explicit env=Environment(account="678602035067", region="us-east-1") in app.py so deterministic bucket names and subnet CIDRs resolve at synth without AWS context lookups.
test_framework: pytest with botocore.stub.Stubber for boto3 (no moto needed; Stubber ships with boto3/botocore). CDK assertions via aws_cdk.assertions.Template for stack tests. FastAPI smoke via fastapi.testclient.TestClient. SPA JS syntax via `node --check`.
build_command: Per package. IaC: `cd projects/video-streaming-app/iac && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt && bash scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh && npx cdk synth`. worker/api: `pip install -r requirements.txt pytest ruff`.
test_command: ruff check . ; pytest ; python -m compileall <module>. IaC synth: `bash scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh && npx cdk synth` (all three stacks). FastAPI boot smoke: start `uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000` with stub env, `curl -f 127.0.0.1:8000/health`, stop.
verification_instructions: Phase 2 VERIFY (cross-feature, run in the convergence loop): (1) from a clean venv in iac/, `bash scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh && npx cdk synth` succeeds for VideoNetworkStack, VideoDataStack, VideoAppStack; (2) `ruff check .` + `python -m compileall` + `pytest` pass across iac/, worker/, api/, iac/lambda/dlq_marker/; (3) FastAPI boots under uvicorn and GET /health returns 200. No cdk deploy/destroy is run in this workflow.
snapshot_or_generated_files: iac/assets/ffmpeg/bin/ (ffmpeg+ffprobe, gitignored, regenerated by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.sh from assets/ffmpeg/FFMPEG.lock -- pinned tag autobuild-2024-11-01-14-16, asset ffmpeg-n7.1-latest-linux64-gpl-7.1.tar.xz, SHA256 in the lock file). frontend/config.json (gitignored; produced by BucketDeployment in AWS or `cp frontend/config.local.json frontend/config.json` locally). cdk.out/ (gitignored). No committed binaries.
environment_constraints: NO cdk deploy and NO cdk destroy in this workflow -- deliverable is deploy-ready + locally runnable only. Account/region fixed: 678602035067 / us-east-1. No port-22 ingress anywhere (admin is Session Manager only). Local dev binds loopback only (127.0.0.1), never 0.0.0.0. fetch-ffmpeg.sh needs egress to the pinned GitHub release at verify time (pinned + SHA256-checked); if the sandbox has no egress, record a retryable blocker -- do NOT vendor a binary.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering in the repo. Conventions come from the two reference apps and DESIGN.md: clear-thinking-app/iac (TypeScript) for CDK teardown discipline -- every stateful resource removalPolicy=DESTROY, S3 auto_delete_objects=True, explicit CloudWatch log groups, BucketDeployment + generated config.json, CfnOutputs; MIRROR ITS STRUCTURE ONLY and translate every API to the Python binding (aws_cdk imports, snake_case props, s3deploy.Source.json_data(...) NOT jsonData). photoshare-app/app (FastAPI + boto3, env-driven config, /health for the ALB, local-vs-AWS via env, local_e2e test) for the web-tier/worker patterns. Each brazil-like package commits separately on branch video-streaming-hardening; never push.
key_patterns: ONE correlation id video_id=uuid4().hex derived ONCE in the web tier and passed through (key prefix input/<video_id>/..., S3 metadata x-amz-meta-video-id, DynamoDB PK, output/<video_id>/..., /media/<video_id>/*); worker parses it from the key PREFIX only, never the filename. update_item everywhere (never put_item). Per-operation exception handling, no bare except, match ClientError on error.response['Error']['Code']. Two-writer Failed status: worker writes Failed on non-zero FFmpeg exit (deterministic, delete, no retry) but RE-RAISES transient boto3/OS errors for redelivery; DLQ-marker Lambda writes Failed (ConditionExpression attribute_exists(video_id)) for the worker-OOM/crash path. Control-message guard on both worker and DLQ-marker (drop+delete s3:TestEvent / non-JSON / no input/<id>/ key). Idempotency: worker skips if already Ready. Signing: load private PEM from Secrets Manager ONCE at startup (lifespan), reuse RSAPrivateKey, 12h TTL refresh; use CF_KEY_PAIR_ID (the PUBLIC KEY id) for the CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id field.

must_fix_carryforwards.HIGH_cf_public_key_id: CloudFront signer needs the PUBLIC KEY id, not the key-group id. Add CfnOutput CfPublicKeyId=public_key.public_key_id (FEAT-005) and inject CF_KEY_PAIR_ID into the web tier env (launch-template EnvironmentFile + local env list); signer uses it for CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id (FEAT-003). Keep CfKeyGroupId only for the trusted-key-group reference.
must_fix_carryforwards.MED_local_media_cors: Add a CloudFront ResponseHeadersPolicy CORS on the /media/* behavior + S3 CORS on the Output bucket allowing the localhost dev origins, so local HLS segment fetches (cross-origin to CloudFront) succeed. Production is same-origin and needs none. (FEAT-005)
must_fix_carryforwards.MED_signing_key_startup: Web tier fetches the private PEM from Secrets Manager at boot; fail the /health check until present and document the deploy order (deploy -> put-secret-value -> ASG replaces initial unhealthy instances). (FEAT-003 + FEAT-006 runbook)
must_fix_carryforwards.MED_vpc_origin_sg: The CloudFront VPC-origin -> internal ALB SG ingress is an unverified AWS-behavior assumption. At implementation time VERIFY against current CloudFront VPC-origins docs, confirm cloudfront.VpcOrigin exists in aws-cdk-lib ^2.170.0, pin ALB + VPC-origin to the SAME explicit private-subnet set, and wire a concrete SG rule (private-subnet-CIDR ingress TCP 80). Confirm on synth. (FEAT-005)
must_fix_carryforwards.MED_signed_cookies_confirmed: Production playback = CloudFront signed COOKIES. CONFIRMED by orchestrator + user; do NOT re-open. Local dev uses signed URLs (rewritten playlist).
must_fix_carryforwards.NIT_gp3_ebs: Set explicit gp3 block devices on both launch templates sized to MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (2 GB) + headroom. (FEAT-005)
must_fix_carryforwards.NIT_local_playlist: Local play-url returns a URL to the local API's rewritten-playlist endpoint whose segment lines are absolute CloudFront signed URLs (not 'a CloudFront signed URL for the playlist'). (FEAT-003)
